tagline: Five tables. One philosophy. Always seasonal.

home.title: Maison Verleux | Restaurants by Chef Elise Verleux

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: A Quiet Revolution at the Table
sections.subheadline: Five restaurants across Brooklyn and Hudson Valley, all sharing one pantry and one obsession with provenance.

sections.name: todays_hours_strip
sections.description: Thin gold-bordered bar showing live status for each location: 'Le Petit Verleux — Open until 11pm', 'Atelier Hudson — Closed Mondays', 'Bar Maribel — Now Seating'.

sections.name: locations_grid
sections.description: Five cards with full-bleed food photo, restaurant name, cuisine line, and Reserve button: Atelier Hudson (Modern American, Hudson NY), Le Petit Verleux (French Bistro, Cobble Hill), Bar Maribel (Spanish small plates, Williamsburg), Otsu by Verleux (Kaiseki tasting, Tribeca), Verleux Pasta Bar (Fort Greene).

sections.name: awards_strip
sections.description: Gold-divider strip listing accolades: 'One Michelin Star — Otsu by Verleux 2023, 2024', 'James Beard Semifinalist — Best Chef NYC 2024', 'New York Times Two Stars — Atelier Hudson'.

sections.name: press_quote
sections.description: Single large pull-quote in Cormorant italic from Pete Wells / NYT, with two smaller quotes from Eater NY and Bon Appétit underneath.

sections.name: private_events_cta
sections.description: Plum panel with photo of long candlelit table inviting inquiries for weddings, rehearsal dinners, and corporate buyouts up to 120 guests.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Five Rooms, One Family
sections.subheadline: Each restaurant is led by its own chef de cuisine under Elise Verleux's direction.

sections.name: restaurant_detail_otsu
sections.description: Full-width interior photo, signature dishes callout ('Hokkaido uni with brown butter dashi', 'A5 Miyazaki, charcoal-grilled'), chef name in italic (Chef de Cuisine Kenji Mori), hours, neighborhood, Reserve + Order buttons.

sections.name: restaurant_detail_atelier
sections.description: Hudson Valley farmhouse photo with description of wood-fired Modern American menu, chef Maya Okonkwo, signature 'Smoked beet tartare' and 'Black trumpet agnolotti'.

sections.name: restaurant_detail_lepetit
sections.description: Bistro detail with chef Antoine Reyes, signature 'Steak frites au poivre' and 'Soufflé Grand Marnier', daily prix fixe note.

sections.name: restaurant_detail_maribel
sections.description: Late-night bar concept by chef Lucia Aranda, signatures 'Gilda skewers', 'Jamón Ibérico de Bellota 36 mo', natural Spanish wine focus.

sections.name: restaurant_detail_pasta
sections.description: Counter-seating pasta bar with chef Dario Castellucci, signatures 'Cacio e pepe tortelloni', 'Squid ink chitarra', daily fresh sheet.

sections.name: ambience_gallery
sections.description: Masonry gallery of 9 candlelit interior and plating shots with the amber overlay treatment.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Autumn Menu
sections.subheadline: Updated 14 October 2024 — sourced from Hawthorne Valley Farm, Montauk Shellfish Co., and Violet Hill Farm.

sections.name: restaurant_selector
sections.description: Horizontal tab selector for the five restaurants with active tab in plum, defaulting to 'Atelier Hudson'.

sections.name: starters
sections.description: Section with gold 1px divider, listing items like 'Delicata Squash Velouté — toasted pepitas, sage oil — $19 (V, GF)' and 'Yellowfin Crudo — yuzu kosho, finger lime — $24 (GF, DF)' with dietary icons.

sections.name: mains
sections.description: Items such as 'Wood-Roasted Hen of the Woods — farro verde, black garlic — $34 (VG)', 'Dry-Aged Duck Breast — quince, foie jus — $46', with italic wine pairing notes underneath each ('Pair with 2019 Domaine Tessier Sancerre Rouge').

sections.name: sides_desserts_drinks
sections.description: Three compact subsections divided by gold lines, ending with cocktail list and a 'Seasonal Special' gold-flagged dessert: 'Concord Grape Pavlova — $16'.

sections.name: allergy_note
sections.description: Small-type footer explaining dietary icon legend (V, VG, GF, DF) and inviting guests to inform servers of allergies.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Reserve Your Table
sections.subheadline: Bookings open 30 days in advance at 9:00 AM ET.

sections.name: resy_widget
sections.description: Embedded Resy-style form with restaurant dropdown, date picker, time slots in 15-min increments, party size 1–8, and special requests textarea.

sections.name: large_party_inquiry
sections.description: Secondary form for parties of 9+ routing to private dining coordinator Margaux Lévy with phone (718) 555-0144.

sections.name: cancellation_policy
sections.description: Short policy block: 48-hour cancellation, $50/seat fee for no-shows at Otsu, credit card hold required.

sections.name: hero
sections.headline: Gather, Beautifully
sections.subheadline: From intimate chef's tables to full buyouts for 120.

sections.name: rooms
sections.description: Three room cards with capacity and layout: 'The Verleux Cellar — seated 24, standing 40', 'Atelier Greenhouse — seated 60', 'Otsu Counter Buyout — 12 guests'.

sections.name: sample_menus
sections.description: Two downloadable PDFs displayed as elegant cards: 'Four-Course Seasonal — $145pp' and 'Chef's Tasting with Pairings — $245pp'.

sections.name: event_gallery
sections.description: Grid of past event photography (weddings, product launches, birthday dinners) with amber overlay.

sections.name: tasting_calendar
sections.description: Upcoming chef's table dates list: 'Truffle Dinner — Nov 14', 'Burgundy & Game — Dec 5', 'New Year's Eve Kaiseki — Dec 31'.

sections.name: inquiry_form
sections.description: Form fields for event type, date, guest count, budget range, and contact info routed to events@maisonverleux.com.
